catalog_observation: Official OS/ArcGIS metadata identifies OS OpenMap Local Important Buildings as polygon geometry in EPSG:27700 with Building Theme (BUILDGTHEM) and Classification (CLASSIFICA) fields. Official OS product page states OS OpenMap Local is free to use and downloadable in vector formats. OS Downloads API SJ GML endpoint was attempted but a concrete record payload was unavailable in this transport.
first_missing_criterion: concrete no-login SJ-tile ImportantBuilding feature payload (up to 50 source records) containing polygon coordinates plus a non-null evidenced BUILDGTHEM and/or CLASSIFICA value; official metadata proves polygon schema and classification fields, but this transport did not yield record payload
